body:
Reported on 1.16.0: a member who has voted to close can still add expenses, as
long as the expense involves only other people — the freeze rule protects the
voter's own amounts, not the list. Agreeing to close should mean done: no new
expenses from that member until they withdraw the vote.

Server: a new expense row from a member with a close vote on an open list is
refused (422 voted_to_close, with row_id so offline clients quarantine rather than
wedge). Clients: no Add button and no Reimburse for a voter. Help text and error
message in all nine languages on both clients; wire contract and spec updated.
Scope as asked: adding. Editing or deleting others' expenses is not covered.
title: expense lists: whoever has agreed to close cannot add expenses
